mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Screener runs filters and a sort over a whole market and pages through the result. Snapshot returns the requested columns for exact tickers (NASDAQ:AAPL). Fields lists the column names the scanner knows for a market.

market.title: Market
market.description: Scanner market to query (the {market} in scanner.tradingview.com/{market}/scan). Defaults to america, or coin for the crypto-top-volume preset. Snapshot mode always uses global so tickers from any exchange can be mixed.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Scanner field names to return, exactly as the scanner names them (close, market_cap_basic, Recommend.All, Perf.YTD ...). Unknown names come back as null. Leave empty for the default set of 27 columns; run mode 'fields' to list all names for a market.

preset.title: Preset
enumTitles: Most active by traded value (stock markets)
preset.description: Ready-made filter and sort definitions, listed in the README. Preset filters are combined with your own filters; the preset's key columns are added to the output; your sortBy overrides the preset sort.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Scanner filter triples: [{"left": "market_cap_basic", "operation": "greater", "right": 1000000000}, {"left": "exchange", "operation": "in_range", "right": ["NASDAQ", "NYSE"]}]. Operations: equal, nequal, greater, egreater, less, eless, in_range, not_in_range, match, nmatch, has, has_none_of, empty, nempty, crosses, crosses_above, crosses_below, above%, below%, in_range%, not_in_range%. A field name as right compares two columns (close egreater SMA200). All filters are ANDed.

filter2.title: Advanced filter (filter2)
filter2.description: Optional scanner filter2 object for OR groups, passed through unchanged: {"operator": "or", "operands": [{"expression": {"left": "RSI", "operation": "less", "right": 30}}, {"expression": {"left": "RSI", "operation": "greater", "right": 70}}]}.

symbols.title: Symbols (snapshot mode)
symbols.description: Exact tickers as EXCHANGE:TICKER for snapshot mode, any mix of exchanges: NASDAQ:AAPL, KRX:005930, BINANCE:BTCUSDT, FX:EURUSD, CRYPTO:BTCUSD. Unknown tickers are listed under missingSymbols in the SUMMARY record.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Scanner field to sort by. Default: the preset's sort, otherwise market_cap_basic for stock markets and volume for the others.

sortOrder.title: Sort order
sortOrder.description: Sort direction. Automatic uses the preset's direction (ascending RSI for oversold-rsi, for example) and descending otherwise.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Rows to return in screener mode (paged 500 per request, one request per second) or symbols to look up in snapshot mode. Ignored in fields mode, which is not charged per row.
